description: Deployed AgentCore runtimes (no secrets). Sync from .bedrock_agentcore.yaml after each launch.

artifactStore.notes: S3 is required for AgentCore artifacts. DynamoDB indexing is optional; set ARTIFACT_DYNAMODB_ENABLED=true only after the table exists.

orchestrator-agent.notes: Frontend / CLI entry point only. Peers via AGENTCORE_PEER_RUNTIME_ARNS (pinned from runtimes.json sdlcPipeline on deploy, includes frontend-agent) and/or baked runtimes.json. Runs full pipeline including in-cloud RDS apply (orchestrator subprocess apply_sql_to_rds.py after database-agent). POSTGRES_MCP_* env required on orchestrator runtime (deploy from .env.local). Public RDS + SG 5432 from 0.0.0.0/0 is sufficient for MVP — no VPC orchestrator needed. Dashboard invokes via AgentCore SDK (skip_postgres=false always). CLI/manual: scripts/invoke-orchestrator-smoke.py --with-frontend. frontend-agent runs when with_frontend=true (still opt-in until Step 5 default flip).

vpcCandidateRuntime.notes: PARKED, NOT WORKING: deployed in vpc-036155f359e2e940c so it could reach RDS, but every InvokeAgentRuntime call fails with HTTP 424 (empty error, no logs, no ENIs created). Root cause confirmed via AWS docs: VPC-mode AgentCore ENIs get a private IP only — no internet access even in public/IGW-routed subnets — so it cannot reach ECR/S3/DynamoDB/CloudWatch/Bedrock control plane without a NAT Gateway or ~5-6 VPC interface/gateway endpoints (~$32+/mo). Needs that infra (or a cheaper alternative) before it's usable. Do not point orchestrator-agent at this runtime until fixed and smoke-tested. See https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/devguide/agentcore-vpc.html

product-agent.notes: Jira opt-in is enabled (AGENTCORE_PRODUCT_SKIP_JIRA=false) with ATLASSIAN_MCP_EMAIL+TOKEN set on the runtime (verified live 2026-07-09; this file previously said skip=true, which was stale). Node required (INSTALL_NODE=true) for the mcp-remote Atlassian bridge — confirm the deployed image still has it when redeploying.

database-agent.notes: AGENTCORE_DATABASE_USE_POSTGRES gates whether the live Postgres MCP tool is attached at agent-build time (deploy/agentcore/agentcore_runtime/bundles.py:206). It was previously unset live (silently dropped by a batch redeploy) because scripts/deploy-agentcore-agents.ps1 had an empty extra=@() for database_agent with no wiring for this flag. Fixed 2026-07-10: the script now always passes AGENTCORE_DATABASE_USE_POSTGRES=true for database_agent, and the runtime was redeployed (version 21) to restore it.

gitlab-agent.notes: Apps-repo publish uses direct ALB MCP + one gitlab_commit_create per app (Sidekiq-safe). CloudFront is not used for publish.

web-crawler-agent.notes: Standalone Firecrawl MCP runtime (not wired to orchestrator MVP chain). Requires Node in image (INSTALL_NODE=true). Scraped markdown stored under runs/<runId>/<app>/docs/PRD/scraped/ in ARTIFACT_S3_BUCKET.

devops-agent.notes: STANDALONE runtime (deployed 2026-07-14) — deliberately NOT wired into the orchestrator MVP chain or AGENTCORE_A2A_PEER_URLS. Image includes terraform CLI (INSTALL_TERRAFORM=true) + infrastructure/ tree, so it can generate and validate per-app Terraform roots in-cloud. It CANNOT run docker builds or terraform apply from AgentCore — actual deploys stay local via scripts/deploy-target-app.ps1 (run-sdlc-local.ps1 -WithDeploy) until the CodeBuild-based cloud deploy path is built. Manifest derivation in-cloud sees the image's baked target-apps state, not S3 artifacts — S3-aware manifests are a future item.

frontend-agent.notes: SDLC chain step after developer-agent, before gitlab-agent (see sdlcPipeline). Cloud runs when PipelineOptions.with_frontend=true (default false until control-plane flip; test via invoke-orchestrator-smoke.py --with-frontend). Local A2A port 9111 (a2a/agent-registry.json). Invoke handler consumes Developer→Frontend handoff (target_app, runId, openapi_path); in s3 mode fetches context.json/openapi.json from runs/<runId>/<slug>/ and uploads generated frontend/ back. target-apps/_template/frontend is baked into the image (Dockerfile COPY). openapi.json appears in S3 only after developer-agent uploads it for that run. Orchestrator resolves this ARN via AGENTCORE_PEER_RUNTIME_ARNS (pinned from sdlcPipeline) or baked runtimes.json.
